topic_ko: 미국 자연보호의 선구자 George Bird Grinnell
_note: 인물 내용일치 지문. theme 발문을 '내용과 일치하지 않는 것'으로 쓰고 한국어 보기 5개 중 1개 거짓. 학술유형(주제/주장/빈칸/함축/무관) 없음.

theme.question: George Bird Grinnell에 관한 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
passage: George Bird Grinnell, one of the leading figures in early American conservation, was born in New York in 1849.
Growing up near Audubon Park, he developed an early interest in birds.
After graduating from Yale University, he joined his first scientific expedition, which led to his career in conservation.
From the late 1870s, he wrote many articles in Forest and Stream calling for wildlife conservation.
He helped found early conservation organizations, including the Audubon Society, and supported the establishment of Glacier National Park in 1910.
Through his writings and public campaigns, he influenced the making of early wildlife protection laws.
Even after his death in 1938, his work in conservation continues to inspire conservationists.
choices: Audubon Park 근처에서 자라며 새에 일찍 관심을 갖게 되었다.
1870년대 후반부터 Forest and Stream에 야생 동물 보호를 촉구하는 글을 썼다.
Yale 대학교를 졸업하기 전에 첫 과학 탐사에 참여했다.
theme.explanation_ko: 본문은 'After graduating from Yale University, he joined his first scientific expedition'이라 하여 Yale '졸업 후' 첫 탐사에 참여했다고 했다. ⑤ '졸업하기 전에' 참여했다는 진술은 본문과 일치하지 않으므로 정답이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①1849년 뉴욕 출생, ②Audubon Park 근처 성장과 새에 대한 관심, ③1870년대 후반 Forest and Stream 기고, ④1910년 Glacier National Park 설립 지원은 모두 본문과 일치한다.

passage: George Bird Grinnell, one of the leading figures in early American conservation, was born in New York in 1849.
Growing up near Audubon Park, he developed an early interest in birds.
After graduate from Yale University, he joined his first scientific expedition, which led to his career in conservation.

Through his writings, he had an influence on making early wildlife protection laws.
grammar.explanation_ko: ② 전치사 After 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 'After graduating'이 옳다. 전치사 뒤에 동사원형을 쓴 'After graduate'는 비문이다. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①분사구문 Growing up, ③앞 절 전체를 보충 설명하는 계속적 용법의 which led, ④articles를 수식하는 현재분사 calling, ⑤전치사 on 뒤 동명사 making은 모두 옳다.

passage: George Bird Grinnell was one of the minor figures in early American conservation.
Growing up near Audubon Park, he developed an early interest in birds.
After graduating from Yale University, he joined his first scientific expedition.
From the late 1870s, he wrote many articles in Forest and Stream calling for wildlife conservation.
He helped found early conservation organizations, including the Audubon Society, and supported Glacier National Park.
Through his writings and campaigns, he influenced the making of early wildlife protection laws.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① Grinnell은 초기 미국 자연 보호의 '주도적인(leading)' 인물 중 한 명이었다는 문맥이므로 leading이 와야 한다. '사소한(minor)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②새에 대한 '관심(interest)', ③야생 동물 '보호(conservation)', ④단체를 '설립하다(found)', ⑤법 제정에 '영향을 주다(influenced)'는 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: George Bird Grinnell, one of the leading figures in early American conservation, was born in New York in 1849.

blocks.A: From the late 1870s, he wrote many articles in Forest and Stream calling for wildlife conservation, and he helped found groups such as the Audubon Society.
blocks.B: Growing up near Audubon Park, he developed an early interest in birds, and after graduating from Yale he joined his first scientific expedition.
blocks.C: Even after his death in 1938, the laws and parks he fought for, including Glacier National Park, keep inspiring conservationists today.

order.explanation_ko: 출생(주어진 글) → (B) 유년기 관심과 Yale 졸업·첫 탐사 → (A) 1870년대 후반 기고와 단체 설립 → (C) 1938년 사후 영향이라는 시간 순서. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 '사후(after his death)'는 마지막이어야 하고, (A)의 '1870년대 후반'은 유년기(B) 뒤라야 한다.

summary.summary_template: Grinnell used his __(A)__ and the organizations he helped create to __(B)__ early American wildlife conservation and its laws.
summary.explanation_ko: Grinnell은 자신의 (A)writings(글)과 설립을 도운 단체들을 통해 미국의 야생 동물 보호와 그 법을 (B)advance(진전시켰다). ④.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 writings, (B)는 advance여야 한다. paintings/weaken/delay/ignore는 본문과 어긋난다.
